name: Sanmu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sanmu city emblem in white: a stylised swirl of two curved strokes, like a letter S.
history: Municipal flag of Sanmu, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2006.

features.role: Sanmu city emblem — a stylised swirl of two curved strokes, like a letter S
